mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with a month-over-month decline in FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation, measured as year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5%, signals an impending monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which lowers corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), weak labor market conditions suppress consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1500) indicate a contraction in the residential construction sector, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with a month-over-month decline in INDPRO, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with a month-over-month increase in PAYEMS, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), elevated borrowing costs suppress corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
